facts.fact: The EPFO service on UMANG lets users check their PF balance
facts.quote: EPFO Users can check their PF balance,Raise claim,Apply for Scheme Certificate,Apply for UAN, Seed UAN with Aadhaar,Check claim status

facts.fact: EPFO's 'View Passbook' service shows the real-time EPF balance and transaction history
facts.quote: View Passbook Check your real-time EPF account balance and transaction history.

facts.fact: The UAN must be activated to check or download the passbook
facts.quote: How can I know the balance in my PF account? Please activate your UAN and check/download your passbook.

behaviour: Concept note 6.2 example: opens the UMANG EPFO passbook service directly (deep link from the UMANG catalogue) with a brief description; no long answer. The hand-off card appears before the text (7.8.7).
fail_if: Gives a long answer instead of the hand-off; gives no link to the UMANG EPFO passbook service; invents a link; points to a third-party app or site.
summary: Added: UMANG EPFO service (PF balance), EPFO 'View Passbook' (balance and transactions), UAN activation needed; UMANG's text listing does not show the 'View Passbook' tile (only its page keywords do).
